title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant
author: Eric Jorgenson

lockedEdition.format: authorized public-service 2020 PDF/EPUB family aligned with Magrathea paperback/hardcover and Scribe ebook metadata
nonNumberedExtras: Now, here is Naval in his own words…

rationale: The official Navalmanack home page offers the full book for free on the site plus downloadable PDF and EPUB, giving this run an authorized, static primary-text source instead of a summary-only bundle.
The frozen PDF exposes the canonical printed table of contents and ISBN block, while the frozen EPUB provides the same 2020 edition text in machine-readable XHTML for section sidecars.
Open Library and WorldCat confirm the 2020 Magrathea paperback / hardcover family and the related Scribe ebook record without introducing a materially different English chapter map.
A later 2025 second edition exists, but this run is locked to the earlier 2020 public-service family because it is the stable, fully accessible, rights-clean source bundle available at run time.
